about: Hand-written expected placement order for examples/test3.py (rules in BUILD_SCHEMATIC.md section 4): layer by layer; blocks with a facing first, then the rest, each by role (foundation, support, wall, floor, stair, window, door, roof, trim, furniture, light), then z, then x; attached blocks wait for their support; the door top appears with the door. Worked out by hand before buildorder.py; revised by hand for the facing-first rule (builder CP-49 attempt 2). Revised by hand again (2026-10-20, placement replay): a log waits for a face along its axis, so the axis=z log (2,0,0) follows the double slab (2,0,1); the upside-down stair (0,2,0) cannot be placed before its neighbours and moves to the end of its layer.
